capabilities: Render PlantUML code blocks into diagrams
Render diagrams as high-resolution SVG or ASCII art
Link to vault notes from within diagrams
Include external .puml files in local rendering
Point rendering at an online, local, or self-hosted server
extras: Known issues are documented: ASCII output only supports sequence diagrams, PicoWeb servers do not support clickable links in png diagrams, and some languages render incorrectly unless SVG is used. Local rendering is noted as less performant than server rendering. Links to plantuml.com for full PlantUML documentation.
problem: Obsidian's built-in diagram support covers Mermaid but cannot render PlantUML code, so PlantUML users have no way to embed their diagrams.

relations.evidence: This plugin uses either the PlantUML Online Server, or a local .jar file for rendering.

summary: Renders PlantUML diagrams from fenced plantuml code blocks via the PlantUML server, a local .jar, or a self-hosted server.
